name: GhostDrawer
description: Headless edge-anchored drawer (sheet) root provider built as a GhostDialog variant. Manages controlled/uncontrolled open state via useControllableState, modal mode (trapped focus, scroll lock, inert background siblings, overlay), logical side placement (start, end, top, bottom), optional writing direction, and deterministic ghost-drawer-* part IDs.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is omitted.

props.name: dir
props.description: Explicit writing direction for mapping logical `start` / `end` sides.

props.name: modal
props.description: Enables modal behavior (trapped focus, scroll lock, inert background, overlay).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: side
props.description: Viewport edge the drawer is anchored to (`'start'`, `'end'`, `'top'`, `'bottom'`).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Drawer trigger, overlay, content, title, description, and close parts.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state across trigger, overlay, and content while the drawer is open.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on GhostDrawerTrigger data-state while the drawer is closed.

states.name: side
states.description: data-side="start" | "end" | "top" | "bottom" on trigger, overlay, and content reports the effective side.

keyboard.Enter: Opens or toggles the drawer on GhostDrawerTrigger or closes on GhostDrawerClose.
keyboard.Space: Opens or toggles the drawer on GhostDrawerTrigger or closes on GhostDrawerClose.
keyboard.Tab: Moves focus forward through tabbable descendants, wrapping within modal drawers.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Moves focus backward through tabbable descendants, wrapping within modal drawers.
keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open drawer when closeOnEscape is enabled and restores focus.

spec.evidence: Approved by Zac (maintainer) in chat on 2026-11-17; recorded in the GHO-91 Linear document (Drawer / Sheet design plan and specification). See the Status line in this spec.
